title: Sequencing: archive display
bodyMd:
Five manuscripts are placed in a single display row, one per numbered position from left to right.

Positions are numbered 1 to 5 in order. The items are Atlas, Ballad, Chronicle, Diary, Epic.

- Chronicle must be in position 3.
- Atlas must precede Ballad.
- Diary and Epic must not occupy consecutive positions.
